title: Conformance smoke suite for prefetching KV-cache + tool-fallbacks
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Recent rollouts of prefix prefetching and aggressive KV-cache eviction changed interleaving behavior for streaming responses. Several downstream integrations that rely on deterministic tool/function-call order and structured JSON patches observed flakiness when fallback routing to smaller quantized model variants occurred. Goal: Ship a small, fast-to-run CI smoke suite that catches regressions across three compatibility layers: streaming frame fidelity, tool/function calling contract (including tool metadata ordering), and structured-output stability when model variants or routing fallbacks are used. The suite should run in the PR gate for runtime changes and as a nightly conformance job that exercises a compact canonical prompt deck ("beacon-deck") and a curated set of lightweight mocks for external tool endpoints. It must detect regressions fast (<= 10m runtime) and provide clear triage artifacts (diffed transcripts, token-level trace, and failing prompt IDs).
acceptance_criteria: A compact test harness (beacon-deck) of ~120 prompts covering: streaming partials, function/tool calling with nested arguments, and structured JSON outputs is checked into infra/tests/conformance/beacon-deck
PR-level CI job 'ci/conformance/smoke-prefetch' runs within 10 minutes and fails on contract drift or missing events
For any failing case the job uploads: raw transcript, token-level timestamps, tool-call events (ordered), and a normalized structured-output diff to the job artifacts page
Tests include at least 3 fallback scenarios: model variant fallback (quantized variant), region fallback, and deduced routing to Dedicated vs Hosted cluster
Triage playbook added to Confluence with clear ownership and triage steps when a conformance test fails
False-positive rate < 1 per 1000 runs (measured over 2 weeks) before enabling required gate on blocking PRs
test_plan: 1) Build small mocks for external tools: echo-service (returns deterministic JSON), slot-resolver (returns latency hysteresis responses), and toxic-detector (simple boolean). 2) Create beacon-deck of prompts focused on edge ordering: overlapping streaming chunks with interleaved tool calls, large prefix KV reuse, and structured outputs that require exact key ordering for downstream parsers. 3) Run the suite against: a) current main runtime binary, b) quantized-8bit variant, c) routing fallback config (simulate capacity limits), d) region-eu fallback. 4) Capture token traces, tool-call event timestamps, and KV-cache hit/miss counters for each run. 5) Lightweight golden-oracle: snapshot of expected event sequence and normalized JSON outputs. 6) Failure policy: small diffs allowed for whitespace and numeric rounding; structural changes or missing tool-call events are failing. 7) Integrate as two CI jobs: quick smoke (PR gate) and nightly extended run (regression window).
test_matrix: Axis B: Model Variant = [main, quantized-8bit, small-fallback]
Axis D: Tool Mocks = [echo-service, slot-resolver, slow-tox-detector]
Axis E: Output Mode = [single-json, jsonl-stream, function-call-first-event]
ci_jobs: ci/conformance/smoke-prefetch: PR-level, matrix over Mode x Model Variant, timeout 10m, artifacts uploaded
ci/conformance/nightly-compat: nightly, full matrix including routing scenarios, collects metrics, runs extended golden comparisons
ci/alerts/conformance-regression: on failing nightly test create issue with prefilled triage template and attach failing artifacts
related_prs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/clients-js/pull/789 - streaming client instrumentation for test traces
